app TypedUserReferences
Given
 Entry { owner:user server=actor, assignee:user?, users:user[], maybeUsers:user[]? }
 policy Entry read=public
When
 crud Entry by=members fields=assignee,users,maybeUsers
 ## Actor equality uses native UserRefs; managed owner remains wire {id} in storage.
 scenario born() -> user by=members
  do
   create Entry {users=[actor]} as entry
   require actor==entry.owner and actor==entry.created_by
   require entry.created_by.id==actor.id
   return entry.owner
 scenario echo(who:user) -> user by=members
  do return who
 scenario echoUsers(value:user[]) -> user[] by=members
  do return value
 scenario echoMaybe(who:user?) -> user? by=members
  do return who
 scenario echoMaybeUsers(value:user[]?) -> user[]? by=members
  do return value
 ## A partial native set preserves user arrays and stamps admitted actor attribution.
 scenario setUser(entry:Entry,who:user) -> user by=members
  do
   require actor==entry.owner
   set entry {assignee=who}
   require entry.assignee==who and entry.updated_by==actor
   require entry.updated_by.id==actor.id
   return entry.updated_by
 scenario users(entry:Entry) -> user[] by=members
  do return entry.users
 scenario maybeUsers(entry:Entry) -> user[]? by=members
  do return entry.maybeUsers
 scenario attribution(entry:Entry) -> user[] by=members
  do
   require entry.created_by==actor and entry.updated_by==actor
   require entry.created_by.id==actor.id and entry.updated_by.id==actor.id
   return [entry.created_by,entry.updated_by]
Then
